courses.title: Master Anchor V2
courses.description: Design, build, test, secure, and ship an Anchor V2 program to devnet against the 2.0.0-rc.1 release candidate, then migrate a 0.31/1.0 codebase to V2 with a map of what changed and why. This is a machine-on-your-desk course: you install and drive the V2 RC toolchain locally — anchor-cli via cargo and avm, rustup's Rust alongside it, and Docker for the solana-verify build — and you deploy to devnet. V2 is an unaudited RC, so the course ends by teaching you to decide honestly when it is the right call and when the maintained 1.x line still is. It does not teach Rust and it does not teach Anchor: it assumes you already ship Anchor programs and want the V2 delta.
courses.creator: 3WECquwCtcKVRYNWBPFWE28ag3b1CDKchLZPXxifAJzQ

courses.title: Rust & TypeScript Fundamentals for Web3
courses.description: Read and write the Rust and TypeScript that real web3 codebases are made of, then ship them: a TypeScript dashboard on Vercel, edge workers in both languages on Cloudflare, and a containerized Rust service on GHCR, all wired to live Solana data with one signed devnet transfer. This is a local-toolchain course, so expect to install as you build: Node in module one, rustup and cargo in module four, Docker in module six, and the Solana CLI in m08-l4, where a local validator stands by as the last-resort fallback for a dry devnet faucet.

courses.title: Solana Payments & Commerce
courses.description: Take real money on Solana end to end: a stablecoin Solana Pay checkout and POS, a webhook-driven back office with reconciliation and refunds, non-custodial subscriptions with dunning, on/off ramps, and x402/MPP machine payments, assembled into one running commerce stack on devnet — where the course touches regulation, it is an engineering framing of the seams, not legal advice. This is a local-toolchain course from the first lab: module one already needs Node 24 and installs packages on your machine, module two adds the Anza Agave CLI (`solana` plus `spl-token`), and from there every lab runs npm workspaces locally against devnet; one step in module eight — `cargo install kora-cli` — additionally needs a Rust toolchain.
